vo_biohybrid_living_tissue.evidence: Native pixels show wet pink folded and striated tissue masses inside the transparent central body, visibly distinct from the clear shell and pale ribs.

vo_biohybrid_engineered_structure.evidence: Both scales retain a transparent polymer mantle and fins, repeated engineered rib members, a central lattice, and multiple cable or connector assemblies around the tissue.

vo_biohybrid_functional_interface.evidence: Tissue and ribs are co-located, but native pixels do not unambiguously show electrode-to-tissue contacts, a load-bearing attachment path, or a contracted region visibly deforming one fin; propulsion causality is only implied.

vo_biohybrid_independent_robot_body.evidence: At thumbnail scale the complete manta-shaped machine is a single foreground body with a closed silhouette, fully separate from the kneeling human operator.

vo_biohybrid_not_biomimetic_cyborg_or_an.evidence: The visible manufactured shell, repeating scaffold ribs, connectors, and cables integrated around distinct flesh make this more than animal-shaped styling; it is neither a human implant nor a sensor backpack on an intact animal.

reference_observation.result: The new fictional operator visibly carries the requested oval-face, brown-eye, and long dark wavy hair cues. No biometric identity or same-person conclusion is made.

boundary: Prompt and runtime audits do not prove pixel fidelity. One failed hard gate makes the rendered qualification fail even though four other gates pass.
